en: A colorized vintage postcard-style image showing a tranquil river scene with a small stone arch bridge of three spans crossing the water. Dense trees and bushes line both banks; a tall tree dominates the right side of the image. On the left foreground, a small rowboat with three people glides along the calm river toward the bridge. The sky is softly tinted in pastel tones with scattered white clouds, giving the scene an idyllic, romantic atmosphere. No visible text appears on the image side.
